note: BLM Kemmerer Field Office campground in cottonwoods on the west bank of the Green River below Fontenelle Reservoir, just north of Seedskadee NWR; picnic area and river fishing access. A willow band lines the bank. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms free designated sites, 2 ADA vault toilets, picnic areas, river access; rec.gov 14716 is info-only (FCFS). Stored riverfront fails on imagery (pads 45 m+ back behind a 15-20 m willow band) -> riverview lead. Pin sits on a vault toilet by a river-access lot south of the bridge, ~460 m from the camping loops.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (stored riverfront, not --AWH): on Esri imagery the camping loops lie in cottonwoods on the inside of the bend; the eastern loop road (about 41.9836,-110.0442) runs ~44 m from the water and the pads sit west of it, with a continuous 15-20 m band of dense willow along the whole bank between them and the river (channel ~55 m wide). No pad within ~50 m over open ground; BLM publishes no site numbers. Recommend riverfront -> riverview.
